newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gas explosion injures 15 in Mexico City.
newsitem.headline: Gas explosion injures 15 in Mexico City.

text.p: Fifteen people were burned on Friday when a spark set off a gas explosion as a truck was unloading propane in a Mexico City suburb, officials said.
The driver, Jesus Miranda, 32 years old, suffered the worst of it with burns over 80 percent of his body, the government news agency Notimex reported, citing a local Red Cross official.
Fourteen other people were burned, six of them seriously, Notimex said.
The gas tanker from the Gas Regio company was filling the tank of an apartment building when the explosion occurred, forcing the evacuation of 2,000 people, Notimex said.
